SCENE sc_001 0-160000 INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
EP31:E1 0-2800 CAMERA: Static medium shot of the heavy, iron-studded dungeon door as the massive bolt loudly slides open.

EP31:E3 2800-4200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana huddled against the stone wall, bound in heavy iron chains, shivering in her torn apron and lifting her tear-streaked face in dread.
EP31:E4 2800-4200 ACTION: Juliana recoils against the damp stonework, her eyes wide with terror as light floods into the dark cell.
EP31:E5 4200-9500 CAMERA: Full shot framed through the arched doorway. Catherine stands imperiously in an ornate, gold-embroidered violet gown, holding a smoldering hot poker and a charred leather-bound book, flanked by two stone-faced guards with lanterns.
EP31:E6 6900-8800 CATHERINE [Cruel, Condescending]: "Look at you."
EP31:E7 9500-10500 CAMERA: Low-angle close-up of Juliana looking up from the stone floor, her gaze hardening despite her fear.
EP31:E8 10500-13800 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Catherine's face, bathed in the orange flickering glow of the red-hot branding iron, smiling with pure malice.
EP31:E9 10500-13800 CATHERINE [Mocking, Venomous]: "The great Lady Juliana Ashcroft."
EP31:E10 13800-17600 CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder wide shot past Catherine looking down at Juliana shackled helplessly on the wet stone floor.
EP31:E11 14000-17600 CATHERINE [Taunting]: "Chained in a dungeon like a common criminal."
EP31:E12 17600-20800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glistening with unshed tears, speaking with quiet defiance.
EP31:E13 17800-20500 JULIANA [Defiant, Steady]: "You seem very pleased."
EP31:E14 20800-24500 CAMERA: Low-angle shot looking up at Catherine towering over Juliana, holding the glowing poker at her side.
EP31:E15 21000-23500 CATHERINE [Smug, Chilling]: "I am."
EP31:E16 24500-29000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of the bent, white-hot tip of the poker radiating heat, with Catherine's face blurred in the background as she gazes down with predatory pleasure.
EP31:E17 25000-28900 CATHERINE [Whispering, Sinister]: "Because this is what you were always meant to be."
EP31:E18 29000-34800 CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder medium shot focusing on Juliana as Catherine presents the charred, singed pages of the botanical book.
EP31:E19 29300-34800 CATHERINE [Scornful]: "Your family dressed you like a lady. They educated you. They gave you a respectable name."
EP31:E20 34800-39000 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's face breaking into an arrogant, haughty laugh.
EP31:E21 35000-38900 CATHERINE [Amused, Spiteful]: "[chuckles] And still you became a disgrace."
EP31:E22 39000-43000 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Juliana's fierce, unwavering gaze as she retorts without hesitation.
EP31:E23 39200-43000 JULIANA [Fierce, Unbroken]: "I became a disgrace when I refused to become cruel."
EP31:E24 43000-48500 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine scowling, cutting back to a shot of Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron manacles against the cold stone floor.
EP31:E25 43200-48500 CATHERINE [Cold, Bitter]: "No. You became a disgrace when Gerald left you standing at the altar."
EP31:E26 48500-54800 CAMERA: Medium shot from floor level looking up at Catherine leaning closer, savoring Juliana's humiliation.
EP31:E27 48900-50800 CATHERINE [Gloating]: "Do you remember?"
EP31:E28 49000-52000 ACTION: Juliana stares up, her breathing steadying as she refuses to break under Catherine's barbs.
EP31:E29 51000-54800 CATHERINE [Viciously Delighted]: "Everyone saw you. Everyone watched him chose Clarisse."
EP31:E30 54800-59000 CAMERA: Close-up of the red-hot iron hovering over the damp stone floor, rising steam and heat waves warping the air, before cutting to Catherine's gloating expression.
EP31:E31 55200-57500 SOUND: Faint sizzling and hissing as ambient moisture touches the scalding iron tip.
EP31:E32 55500-58800 CATHERINE [Quietly Venomous]: "And everyone watched you walk away alone."
EP31:E33 59000-65500 CAMERA: Close-up pushing in on Juliana's illuminated, dignified face.
EP31:E34 59200-61300 JULIANA [Proud, Measured]: "Gerald chose money."
EP31:E35 61500-63500 JULIANA [Resolute]: "Clarissa chose a coward."
EP31:E36 63800-65300 JULIANA [Unyielding]: "I chose myself."
EP31:E37 65500-67500 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's face tightening in disgust.
EP31:E38 65600-67400 CATHERINE [Disgusted]: "You chose a beggar."
EP31:E39 67500-70500 CAMERA: Low-angle shot of Juliana lifting her chin with unwavering pride.
EP31:E40 67600-69800 JULIANA [Fierce, Proud]: "I chose a man."
EP31:E41 70500-73300 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine sneering down at her.
EP31:E42 70800-73200 CATHERINE [Contemptuous]: "A scarred nobody."
EP31:E43 73300-77600 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana sitting erect against the dungeon wall, her hands resting calmly in her lap.
EP31:E44 73500-77600 JULIANA [Resolute, Dignified]: "A man with more honor than the people sitting above this dungeon."
EP31:E45 77600-80500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine, holding the smoldering iron between them.
EP31:E46 77800-80200 CATHERINE [Incredulous, Mocking]: "You call that marriage?"
EP31:E47 80500-83200 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana's clear blue eyes, shining with profound conviction.
EP31:E48 80800-83200 JULIANA [Pure, Sincere]: "I call it love."
EP31:E49 83200-88000 CAMERA: High-angle wide shot looking straight down through the ceiling iron grating into the deep dungeon shaft where Catherine looms over Juliana.
EP31:E50 83500-87400 CATHERINE [Mocking, Hysterical Laugh]: "[laughs] Love? Look where your precious love brought you."
EP31:E51 87500-91200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana looking directly up past the glowing tip of the iron poker into Catherine's eyes.
EP31:E52 87800-91200 JULIANA [Firm, Piercing]: "To a place where I can still look you in the eyes."
EP31:E53 91200-94200 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine, her lips curling in indignant disbelief.
EP31:E54 91400-94200 CATHERINE [Incredulous, Offended]: "You think love makes you better than me?"
EP31:E55 94200-98200 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana speaking calmly and razor-sharp.
EP31:E56 94500-98200 JULIANA [Calm, Cutting]: "No. But cruelty certainly doesn't make you better than me."
EP31:E57 98200-103500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine sweeping her arm out, flaunting her aristocratic privilege and opulence.
EP31:E58 98500-103300 CATHERINE [Incensed, Boastful]: "I have beauty, money, family, status! What do you have?"
EP31:E59 103500-108800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her expression serene and grounded in moral superiority.
EP31:E60 103700-108500 JULIANA [Quiet, Powerful]: "Knowledge. Love. And people who need me."
EP31:E61 108800-110500 CAMERA: Tight shot of Catherine's gloved hands holding Juliana's mother's partially burned botanical volume, 'The Virtues of Plants & Herbs'.
EP31:E62 110200-111400 CATHERINE [Sneering, Derisive]: "[scoffs] Peasants? People?"
EP31:E63 111500-118200 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine casually holding the ancient book while pacing slowly before Juliana.
EP31:E64 111600-118200 CATHERINE [Arrogant, Elitist]: "That is why you were born in the wrong world. Women like me are meant to be admired. Women like you are meant to serve."
EP31:E65 118200-122500 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Juliana's face, tilting her head with an insightful, knowing smirk.
EP31:E66 118400-122000 JULIANA [Piercing, Provocative]: "Then why are you so desperate to make me kneel?"
EP31:E67 122000-124000 ACTION: Catherine's smug expression freezes, her eyes widening in momentary shock and fury as the blow lands squarely.
EP31:E68 124000-130800 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot of Juliana, her voice ringing clearly through the subterranean chamber.
EP31:E69 124200-130500 JULIANA [Accusatory, Commanding]: "If you were truly powerful, Catherine, you wouldn't need me to bow."
EP31:E70 130800-133000 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine completely losing control, her aristocratic facade shattering into sheer rage.
EP31:E71 131000-132800 CATHERINE [Enraged Scream]: "Enough!"
EP31:E72 133000-134500 CAMERA: Close-up of the red-hot poker pressing directly down into the delicate open pages of the botanical book.
EP31:E73 133200-134500 SOUND: Hiss of scorched parchment and curling white smoke rising as paper blackens under extreme heat.
EP31:E74 134500-138000 CAMERA: Medium two-shot. Catherine holds the smoldering book right before Juliana's face.
EP31:E75 134500-138000 CATHERINE [Hateful, Malicious]: "This pathetic book is the only thing you still have from your mother."
EP31:E76 138000-140500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana, her emotional composure breaking into pure grief and panic.
EP31:E77 138000-140500 ACTION: Tears spill rapidly down Juliana's cheeks as she reaches forward in vain, restrained by her heavy iron chains.
EP31:E78 138400-140400 JULIANA [Desperate, Weeping]: "[gasping] Give it back!"
EP31:E79 140500-143800 CAMERA: Low-angle shot of Catherine grinning with sadistic triumph, looking down at Juliana's despair.
EP31:E80 140700-143800 CATHERINE [Gloating, Sadistic]: "There. Finally. Something still hurts you."
EP31:E81 143800-145500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana screaming out in absolute anguish.
EP31:E82 144000-145500 JULIANA [Screaming, Agonized]: "No!"
EP31:E83 145500-151200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine slowly driving the glowing branding tip into the spine of the open book, watching the embers consume the pages.
EP31:E84 145600-151200 CATHERINE [Vicious, Final]: "One flame, and your mother's life's work becomes ash."
EP31:E85 151200-155200 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot. Catherine lowers the charred book and suddenly swings the glowing orange iron tip straight up toward Juliana's face.
EP31:E86 151500-155200 ACTION: Juliana recoils back against the hard dungeon wall, gasping for breath in raw terror as the searing iron stops inches from her eyes.
EP31:E87 155200-160000 CAMERA: Extreme macro close-up of Juliana's wide, trembling eye. The brilliant orange ember of the hot poker reflects clearly in the center of her pupil, holding on the terrifying cliffhanger before an abrupt cut.
